Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in synthesizing and comparing the release dates of the two films. Although the WebSurfer retrieved accurate information that "Man's Search for Happiness" premiered at the 1964 World's Fair and "Tell It to the Bees" premiered in 2018, the Planner failed to decisively confirm and finalize the earliest release date for each film earlier in the task. Instead, it repeatedly issued redundant instructions to recheck dates that had already been adequately verified. This unnecessary repetition caused ambiguity and delayed the conclusion. The error could have been avoided had the Planner recognized that the 1964 release date for "Man's Search for Happiness" definitively preceded any potential release date for "Tell It to the Bees" (2018).
